start: Owner signed in, real gym online, gym server has paying built in, MettleUp has added its UPI and bank details; Settings, Gym tab

steps.action: In the card 'Your MettleUp plan', tap 'Pay MettleUp'
user_sees: Card text 'Pay for MettleUp by UPI or bank transfer, and see when your payment is confirmed.'
Page 'Pay MettleUp', subtitle 'Pay for your MettleUp plan by UPI or bank transfer'
'Loading…', then one line saying the plan the gym is on now
Button 'Back to Settings'
must_not: The card shown to a desk person or on the demo gym
An endless Loading

steps.action: Under '1. Pick your plan' choose Starter or Pro, and '1 month' or '1 year'
user_sees: The price in large figures with 'for 1 month' or 'for 1 year'
During the free trial: one line saying when the paid time starts
'The price for one branch. More than one branch? Message MettleUp for your total before you pay.'
The heading of card 2 and the 'Amount paid' box follow the price
must_not: A price that does not match the picked plan
The amount box keeping the old price before the owner typed in it

steps.action: Under '2. Pay ₹{price}' scan the QR with a UPI app, or use the bank details
user_sees: 'Scan with any UPI app (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, your bank’s app). The amount is filled in.'
Link 'On a phone? Pay with a UPI app'
'UPI ID', 'Name', and 'Or pay by bank transfer (NEFT or IMPS)' with Account name, Account number, IFSC, Bank
'In the payment note, write your gym code {code} so we know it is you.'
must_not: A QR with a different amount from the heading
Payment details of anyone but MettleUp
An empty gym code with no hint

steps.action: Under '3. I have paid' pick 'UPI', type the 12-digit reference number, check 'Amount paid', tap 'Send for confirmation'
user_sees: 'Send us the reference number, so MettleUp can find your payment and confirm it.'
Button 'Sending…'
Toast 'Sent. MettleUp will check the payment and confirm it here.'
The page scrolls to the top; 'Your payments' shows the new one as waiting
The reference box is empty again
must_not: The plan shown as paid before MettleUp confirms
Two rows from one tap
The typed reference lost when the send fails

steps.action: Open the page again after MettleUp confirmed the payment
user_sees: The payment shows a green confirmed pill with its line
The plan line at the top shows the new plan
must_not: Still waiting after it was confirmed
A confirmed pill with the old plan line

start: Owner pays by bank transfer instead of UPI

steps.action: Send money by NEFT or IMPS to the account shown, then under 'Paid by' pick 'Bank transfer'
user_sees: The hint changes to 'The UTR number your bank shows for the transfer.'
must_not: The 12-digit UPI rule applied to a bank UTR

steps.action: Type the UTR and tap 'Send for confirmation'
user_sees: Toast 'Sent. MettleUp will check the payment and confirm it here.'
A waiting line in 'Your payments'
must_not: The payment saved as UPI

start: Owner on a gym whose server has 'Pay online' switched on; and the owner who types the page address

steps.action: Open Pay MettleUp
user_sees: A 'Pay online' block above 'Your payments', with the gym's receipts (exact words unknown: not read in this step)
must_not: The block shown while the server switch is off
Receipts of another gym

steps.action: Type the address of Pay MettleUp in the browser
user_sees: The same page
must_not: A blank page
The page for a desk person

start: Owner on Pay MettleUp; wrong input and missing parts

steps.action: Tap 'Send for confirmation' with the reference box empty
user_sees: A red line under 'Reference number (UTR)' (exact words unknown)
must_not: Anything sent to MettleUp
A toast that says Sent

steps.action: Clear 'Amount paid' or type letters, then tap 'Send for confirmation'
user_sees: Under the box: 'Type the amount you paid, in rupees, like 1499.'
must_not: A payment of ₹0 sent

steps.action: Send the same reference number a second time
user_sees: A red line above the form with the reason (exact words unknown)
The typed reference stays in the box
must_not: Two waiting payments for one reference

steps.action: Open the page on a gym whose server does not have paying yet
user_sees: 'Paying MettleUp here is not ready yet'
'To pay now, message MettleUp and we will send you the payment details. Your gym keeps working as it is.'
must_not: A red error
A form that cannot send

steps.action: Open the page when MettleUp has not added its payment details
user_sees: 'Payment is not available yet'
'MettleUp has not added its payment details here yet. Message MettleUp to pay. Your gym keeps working as it is.'
must_not: An empty QR
Steps 1 to 3 with nothing to pay to

steps.action: A desk person, or anyone on the demo gym, opens the page address
user_sees: 'Only the gym owner can pay MettleUp'
'Sign in as the owner, with the gym online, to pay.'
must_not: MettleUp's bank details
The gym's payments to MettleUp

steps.action: Open the page with the internet off
user_sees: A red line with the reason
Button 'Try again'
must_not: A blank page

start: Owner with payments in every state

steps.action: Read 'Your payments'
user_sees: One pill and one line per payment: waiting (amber), confirmed (green), not confirmed (red)
Only the 5 newest
must_not: A not-confirmed payment shown as waiting for ever
Older payments with no way to see them said nowhere

steps.action: After a not-confirmed payment, send a new reference number
user_sees: A new waiting line above the old one
must_not: The old not-confirmed line turns to waiting
The form is blocked

steps.action: Open the page on a gym with a lifetime plan
user_sees: The plan line and past payments only
must_not: Steps 1 to 3 asking a lifetime gym to pay

steps.action: Open Settings before and after the first visit to Pay MettleUp
user_sees: A 'new' dot beside the 'Pay MettleUp' button, then no dot
must_not: The dot stays for ever

start: Owner and a desk person of the same gym

steps.action: The owner opens Pay MettleUp
user_sees: MettleUp's UPI ID and bank account, the gym's own payments and plan
must_not: Payments or plan of another gym
The owner's own bank or card details asked for or stored

steps.action: The desk person opens Settings and then the page address
user_sees: No 'Your MettleUp plan' card
'Only the gym owner can pay MettleUp'
must_not: What the gym pays MettleUp
The reference numbers the owner sent
